BiblicalUsage: Rômêmuth is how the Bible says exaltation. It stands in Isaiah 33:3: "…the noise of the tumult the people fled…".
TheologicalSignificance: I believe rômêmuth is worth knowing, because nothing in Scripture is there by accident.
